parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese.

- en: English.

Default value: en.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun pvtz bind-resolver-rule-vpc --lang en --rule-id hr0000 --vpc VpcType=STANDARD VpcId=vpc-f8zvrvr1payllgz380000 RegionId=cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun pvtz BindResolverRuleVpc --region cn-hangzhou --Vpc.1.VpcType STANDARD --Vpc.1.VpcId 'vpc-f8zvrvr1payllgz380000' --RuleId hr0000 --Lang en --Vpc.1.RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
